verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const dir="supabase/migrations";if(!fs.existsSync(dir))process.exit(79);const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith(".sql"));const guarded=files.some(f=>{const s=fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,f),"utf8");return /create\s+trigger\s+\S+\s+before\s+insert\s+or\s+update\s+on\s+public\.event_rsvps/i.test(s)&&/attended_at/i.test(s)&&/\braise\b/i.test(s)});if(!guarded){console.error("SCAN-696: no BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on public.event_rsvps checks attended_at, so the update-own RLS policy still lets a member self-approve, self-mark attendance and set any plus_ones on their own RSVP row.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The write policies on event_rsvps checked ownership alone, authenticated held UPDATE on every column, and no trigger refused a value, so a member could PATCH their own row with approval_status approved, attended_at now, attended_by themselves and plus_ones 500 and skip the host queue, pass checkInEvent and count as host-attested present (confirmed against the live catalog: two triggers, four policies, column-level UPDATE on attended_at for authenticated). Migration 20270345011700 adds guard_event_rsvp_member_write, a SECURITY INVOKER BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger (trg_a_event_rsvps_member_write_guard, named to fire before the capacity and suspension triggers) that returns NEW for service_role, postgres, supabase_admin and guest rows (profile_id null), and otherwise refuses with 42501 an insert that is approved, attended or carries any guest_*, seat_token_hash or from_ticket_id value, and an update that changes attended_at, attended_by, guest_*, seat_token_hash, from_ticket_id or moves approval_status anywhere but pending. INVOKER is deliberate: a definer body reads its owner as current_user and would exempt every write. event_rsvps_plus_ones_check becomes 0..5, the app's MAX_PLUS_ONES (live max was 0). EXECUTE is revoked and the function has an internal verdict in scripts/function-grants.txt. Pinned by supabase/tests/event_rsvps_member_write_guard.test.sql (20 pgTAP assertions: every forged write as a member refused, the app's pending/withdraw/re-join writes land, service_role approve and attend pass, the plus-ones cap binds every writer, the anon guest door still writes) and lib/events/rsvp-write-guard.test.ts (trigger shape, invoker mode, frozen column list, ceiling equals both app clamps). The trigger logic was also executed against a stub table on a local Postgres 16: every expected refusal and pass held, including a SECURITY DEFINER door writing attended_at under the authenticated role.
